entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R case No. 1572 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned SDJM, Kendrapada arising out Marsaghai P.S. Case No. 295 of 2023, for alleged commission of offences under Sections. 419/420/467/407 of the IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Sessions Judge Kendrapara, I/c by order dated 30.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted that the learned counsel that the allegations against the petitioner is that he lured the informant promising higher return and in the process he allegedly duped of Rs. 1,00,000/-
(Rupees one lakh).

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner had no intention to cheat and in fact tried to invest the amount but for reasons beyond his control the investment could not be made.
6.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel on instruction that prima facie without prejudice to his rights and to prove his bona fide, petitioner is prepared to pay a sum of Rs. 30,000/- to the informant.
7. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer during currency of investigation.

sentences.text: Taking note of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
9. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall deposit a sum of Rs. 30,000/- before release.
Such amount shall be released in favour of the informant on his executing an indemnity bond for the said amount.
And, the amount so paid shall abide by the final result of the case at hand.
10. While releasing the Petitioner on bail, learned Court below shall verify assertion regarding criminal antecedent of similar nature.
If it comes to the fore that the Petitioner has any similar antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Soumya Signed Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL Designation: Junior Stenographer Reason: Authentication Location: High Court of Orissa Date: 22-Jun-2023 11:41:31
